FX.title: [USD/JPY] DOWN: AI Detects Bearish Mean Reversion Below MA20
tldr_points: Price is trading roughly 290 pips below the 20-period moving average at 156.12, indicating a stretched bearish deviation.
The RSI-14 is reading 31.41, a deeply oversold condition that suggests exhaustion selling and potential for mean reversion back to the MA20.
Upcoming US Non-Farm Payroll data introduces asymmetric volatility, favoring downside continuation in the absence of a hawkish Fed surprise.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY faces bearish pressure at 156.12, trading well below MA20 with an RSI-14 of 31.41; mean reversion offers downside continuation into NFP.
FX.comment: Bearish mean reversion setup with price deeply below MA20 and oversold RSI confirming downside momentum into NFP.
